Third-Party License Inventory

Every third-party dependency vendored under /Engine/Source/ThirdParty/ is enumerated below per Section 2 of the Rev 10 master plan. Full upstream license text for each dependency lands as Licenses/<Name>.txt at the moment the dependency is actually integrated — those .txt files do not yet exist; the path column shows where each will be placed. XAutomationTool's release pipeline aggregates the full set into a NOTICES.html bundle attached to every signed shipping build.

Name Version Source URL License type License file path Intended use
Jolt Physics TBD at integration https://github.com/jrouwe/JoltPhysics MIT Licenses/Jolt.txt XPhysics — deterministic rigid-body simulation in lockstep mode
Sleef TBD at integration https://sleef.org/ BSL-1.0 Licenses/Sleef.txt Deterministic transcendental math substitution on sim-path TUs
Vulkan-Headers TBD at integration https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers Apache-2.0 Licenses/Vulkan-Headers.txt XVulkanRHI — Vulkan API headers
Vulkan-Loader TBD at integration https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Loader Apache-2.0 Licenses/Vulkan-Loader.txt XVulkanRHI — runtime Vulkan loader
VulkanMemoryAllocator TBD at integration https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator MIT Licenses/VulkanMemoryAllocator.txt XVulkanRHI — GPU memory allocation
OpenXR-SDK TBD at integration https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK Apache-2.0 Licenses/OpenXR-SDK.txt XOpenXR — VR/AR runtime integration (Quest 3-class HMDs)
Recast/Detour TBD at integration https://github.com/recastnavigation/recastnavigation ZLib Licenses/Recast.txt XNavigation — navmesh generation and pathfinding
CPython TBD at integration https://www.python.org/ PSF Licenses/CPython.txt XPython — embedded scripting (post-MVP)
Roslyn TBD at integration https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn MIT Licenses/Roslyn.txt XHT parser reference only — not embedded in shipping builds
MikkTSpace TBD at integration https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace ZLib Licenses/MikkTSpace.txt XMaterials — tangent-space calculation
ICU TBD at integration https://icu.unicode.org/ Unicode License Licenses/ICU.txt XLocalization runtime — Unicode handling, collation, locales
zstd TBD at integration https://github.com/facebook/zstd BSD-3-Clause Licenses/zstd.txt XSerialization — binary compression
Brotli TBD at integration https://github.com/google/brotli MIT Licenses/Brotli.txt XPak — package compression
tl_expected (TartanLlama/expected) 1.3.1 (header-version macros TL_EXPECTED_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH) https://github.com/TartanLlama/expected CC0-1.0 (with optional MIT) ../tl_expected/LICENSE.txt XCore — Result<T,E> C++20 polyfill of std::expected (per XCore-4a Rev 3 Section 13.1 fix B-M6). Selected at compile time via __cpp_lib_expected feature-test; the polyfill is bypassed on C++23 toolchains that ship std::expected natively.

Notes. Versions are marked "TBD at integration" because the engine is in pre-bootstrap scaffold phase; each version will be pinned the moment the dependency is actually integrated into its consuming system. The cryptographic library backing XSecurity (Section 2 Network security row — OpenSSL / BoringSSL or a FIPS-140-3 validated provider) is not in this initial inventory because its selection is deployment-time configurable and lands when XSecurity is implemented at Layer 13.

Build-tool dependencies (XBT and tooling)

Build-time-only dependencies consumed by the XBT toolchain (under /Engine/Source/Programs/XBT/). These do not ship in player-facing binaries; they are pulled by the .NET build host. Versions are concrete because XBT is integrated. Each Licenses/<Name>.txt file lands when the corresponding upstream license text is vendored alongside the dependency — the path column shows where each will be placed; the .txt files do not yet exist and are forward-looking per the engine-tier table's pattern above.

Name Version License Source URL License file path Used by Notes
Blake3 1.1.0 CC0-1.0 / public-domain-equivalent https://github.com/xoofx/Blake3.NET Licenses/Blake3.txt XBT.Core (IoHash) BLAKE3 reference impl for .NET.
FlatSharp.Runtime 7.9.0 Apache-2.0 https://github.com/jamesqo/FlatSharp Licenses/FlatSharp.Runtime.txt XBT.Manifest (FBS readers/writers) Idiomatic .NET FlatBuffers; codegen via MSBuild.
FlatSharp.Compiler 7.9.0 Apache-2.0 https://github.com/jamesqo/FlatSharp Licenses/FlatSharp.Compiler.txt XBT.Manifest (build-time codegen) Build-time only; not redistributed.
xunit 2.x Apache-2.0 https://github.com/xunit/xunit Licenses/xunit.txt XBT.Tests Unit-test framework.
xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.x Apache-2.0 https://github.com/xunit/visualstudio.xunit Licenses/xunit.runner.visualstudio.txt XBT.Tests Test runner.
Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.x MIT https://github.com/microsoft/vstest Licenses/Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk.txt XBT.Tests Test SDK.
coverlet.collector 6.x MIT https://github.com/coverlet-coverage/coverlet Licenses/coverlet.collector.txt XBT.Tests (optional) Code coverage collector.
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Scripting 4.11.0 MIT https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn Licenses/Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Scripting.txt XBT.Configuration (BuildCsCompiler) Roslyn .Build.cs escape hatch per Contract Rev 13 Section 9.6 / XBT.html Rev 4 Section 3.6. Loaded on-demand only for modules that ship a .Build.cs; pure-TOML projects never page Roslyn in at runtime.
